descriptions.text: Geranial is a monoterpenoid that is (2E,6E)-octa-2,6-dienal substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 7. It has a role as a volatile oil component and a plant metabolite. It is a polyprenal, a monoterpenoid and an enal.

uses: Component of many commercial oils including lemon grass, verbena, lemon, and orange; [Merck Index] Used as a flavoring agent and fragrance and an intermediate for the synthesis of other fragrances, vitamin A, ionone, and methylinone; [HSDB]

Used primarily as a starting material for the manufacturing of fragrance ingredients. Also used as a fragrance ingredient in fragrance compositions typically at a level of 0.1 to 1%. These compositions are used to perfume a wide variety of consumer products.
In the synthesis of vitamin A, ionone and methylinone. As a flavor and in perfumery for its citrus effect.

Cymbopogon atau Serai adalah sebuah genus tumbuhan pulau tropis di Asia, Afrika, dan Australia dalam keluarga rumput.
Beberapa spesies (terutama Cymbopogon citratus) umum ditanam sebagai tumbuhan obat dan makanan.

en.title: Citral
en.extract: Citral is an acyclic monoterpene aldehyde. Being a monoterpene, it is made of two isoprene units. Citral is a collective term which covers two geometric isomers that have their own separate names; the E-isomer is named geranial (trans-citral; α-citral) or citral A. The Z-isomer is named neral (cis-citral; β-citral) or citral B. These stereoisomers occur as a mixture, often not in equal proportions; e.g. in essential oil of Australian ginger, the neral to geranial ratio is 0.61.
